title: Review catch exception
why: Broad handlers can hide unexpected failures or mix unrelated recovery policies.
suggestion: Prefer specific catches where practical. At an intentional isolation or translation boundary, preserve the failure and its cause.
limitations: Recognizes complete catch headers whose first unqualified type is Exception or Throwable; compatible multi-catch alternatives and multiline headers are supported.

Direct rethrows of the unchanged caught binding are excluded when preceded only by recognizable log/logger observation calls. Conditional recovery, assignment, other helpers and translated exceptions remain reportable.
Logging recognition is conventional evidence, not resolved call-effect analysis. Qualified broad types and arbitrary control-flow equivalence are not inferred.
Comments and quoted examples are masked without changing source positions. Findings remain occurrence-based.
